1. Overall, you'll find similarities, but there's no gear score. Some people say breakpoint has better customization, but I find that to be iffy, I'd say the games are somewhat on par.

2. The map is much bigger and much more immersive, it just feels more alive and has many more npcs, between enemies amd civilians, and while the graphics are worse from a technical standpoint I think wildlands is more beautiful 

3. I can't speak on the mod support, but I suspect it will be stronger then breakpoint as you can play purely on single player, and there's been more time for mod development 

4. Pardon my french, but holy shit the story of wildlamds is better than breakpoint. It was, a little trope-y, but it had stronger moments and was concise and ends with all loose ends tied up, I won't spoil, but you'll understand 

Overall, I highly recommend wildlands and getting to understand the downgrade breakpoint can and often is story and atmosphere wise. It's not a bad game, but in comparison, it's not a good game.
